method: independent LLM judge scoring features from agent.patch only (no execution, no access to runtime results); fractional credit allowed

rationale.sidekiq_fake: :fake set via type-scoped before hooks for :model and :request (declaration order makes fake win over the retained global inline hook), with opt-back-in via a `sidekiq: :inline` around hook — but that around wraps the type-scoped before hooks, so `Sidekiq.testing!(:fake)` may clobber the block-scoped inline for tagged examples unless Sidekiq 8's two APIs act at different precedence levels; other spec types remain inline.
rationale.log_level_fatal: Log level changed to :warn, not :fatal — captures most of the debug-SQL-logging win by a different value, but a Rails.logger.level == fatal check fails.
rationale.paperclip_stub: Identified media_attachment/Paperclip as the priciest fabricator in notes but explicitly left it for a future phase.
rationale.redis_flushdb: redis.del(redis.keys) untouched; the agent measured the hook as negligible and deliberately skipped it.
rationale.factory_cascades: Both known cascades removed: status after_create bookmark and user after_create 2x login_activity.
rationale.fabricate_build: Replaced account's already-non-persisting Fabricate.build(:user) with a plain User.new helper (a speed change, not a persistence fix); no spoiled persisted association converted to build.
rationale.password_encryption: Helper still passes password: '123456789' to User.new so BCrypt still runs per user; the agent's own stackprof even flagged BCrypt at ~4% but did not fix it.

grading.note: speed grade cannot be derived from a diff; reused from runtime measurement
